XECH Multipurpose Lamp & Handheld Flashlight (Magneto) – Smart Lighting for Every Situation

The XECH Multipurpose Lamp & handheld flashlight (Magneto) is a powerful, versatile, and modern lighting solution designed for homes, workshops, travel, and emergency use. Engineered with intelligent modular accessories, this lamp adapts effortlessly to multiple environments. Whether you need focused task lighting, hands-free illumination, or a portable torch, this innovative lighting tool delivers reliable performance with premium build quality.

Built for convenience and durability, this multipurpose LED lamp features a lamp head with neodymium magnets that allows quick attachment to metal surfaces. From garage walls and tool racks to metal shelves and vehicles, the strong magnetic hold ensures stability without compromising flexibility. The compact design and ergonomic form make it easy to carry and use as a handheld flashlight whenever required.

Versatile Mounting Options for Maximum Utility

The is designed to go beyond standard lighting products by offering multiple mounting and positioning options. The included metal base plate and rod provide a sturdy freestanding setup, making it ideal for desks, study tables, bedside use, and workstations. This configuration ensures optimal light direction for reading, working, or ambient illumination.

For users who need flexible placement, the clamp attachment allows secure mounting on table edges, shelves, headboards, or rails. This hands-free setup is perfect for content creators, repair work, cooking, or late-night study sessions. The adjustable angle ensures targeted lighting exactly where you need it, reducing eye strain and improving productivity.

The included stick attachment transforms the into a portable handheld flashlight with extended reach. This setup is especially useful during power cuts, outdoor activities, camping trips, and vehicle emergencies. The lightweight structure ensures comfort during prolonged use while maintaining a firm grip.

Powerful LED Performance with Efficient Charging

Equipped with energy-efficient LED technology, the delivers bright, uniform illumination while consuming minimal power. The light output is suitable for both focused tasks and general lighting, making it a dependable choice for everyday use.

Charging is simple and universal with the included USB C charging cable. This modern charging standard ensures faster power delivery, compatibility with power banks, laptops, and wall adapters, and long-term reliability. The rechargeable battery eliminates the need for disposable cells, making this lamp an eco-friendly and cost-effective lighting solution.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Multipurpose design works as a lamp and handheld flashlight
  • Lamp head with neodymium magnets for strong and secure attachment
  • Durable metal base plate and rod for stable desk or floor placement
  • Clamp attachment for hands-free use on tables, shelves, and rails
  • Stick attachment for extended reach and portable flashlight use
  • Bright, energy-efficient LED light for indoor and outdoor applications
  • USB C charging cable for fast, universal, and reliable charging
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly construction
  • Ideal for home, office, garage, camping, and emergency situations

Ideal Use Cases

The is suitable for a wide range of applications including study lighting, work-from-home setups, repair and maintenance tasks, photography and videography lighting, camping lantern replacement, and emergency backup lighting. Its adaptable design ensures that one product meets multiple lighting needs without clutter.

Designed with premium materials and user-focused functionality, this lighting solution combines innovation, durability, and modern aesthetics. If you are looking for a reliable, flexible, and future-ready lighting product, the is the perfect addition to your everyday essentials.
